say: Now the desk runs the kept script for each pull request. Only the inputs change. Open it, wait until it offers merge, merge it, have Jenkins build it, smoke-test the preview. If every scenario passes, promote to Dev. If not, comment on the pull request and say which failed. Five pull requests: four pass and go to Dev. The fifth, Renewals: none during the audit, breaks the renewal scenario, and gets the comment instead. That's the release catching a bad change before it reaches anyone, with zero tokens. And before every act, the guard: is the form still what was pinned?
